ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, and clients against the French national sanctions frozen-assets file (TPCIMF), FICOBA bank account file, EU consolidated restrictive measures, UN Security Council consolidated list, OFAC SDN list where extraterritorially applicable, and FATF high-risk jurisdiction lists; enhanced due diligence required for politically exposed persons (PEPs) per ACPR and AMF guidance.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RCS (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés) via Infogreffe (www.infogreffe.fr) and INPI name reservation portal (data.inpi.fr)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All corporate names must be expressed in French; Latin alphabet with French diacritical marks is mandatory; names must be lawful, non-misleading, and not convey a false identity; foreign-sourced names must be transliterated to Latin script and reviewed for phonetic equivalency.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: In the event of name rejection by the RCS or INPI, a written administrative appeal must be filed within 10 days before the presiding judge of the commercial court (Juge Commissaire); the appellant must provide evidence of prior availability search and full renunciation of the rejected tokens; a renewed availability search and re-filing is also required within the same procedural deadline.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual offices are not recognized as a registered seat for a SARL; however, commercial domiciliation services provided by licensed business centers are permitted provided the address receives mail and administrative correspondence and maintains an accessible physical location for statutory records and official inspections.

incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce du lieu du siège social
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Acte constitutif et statuts de la société
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum capital of 1 euro for SARL; contributions in cash or in kind; no escrow account required but statutes must specify payment schedule
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The First Board of Directors of the proposed SARL resolves unanimously as follows: The share capital is fixed at one thousand euros (1,000 EUR), divided into one thousand (1,000) shares of one euro (1 EUR) each, subscribed in full by the initial shareholders listed below. The registered office is adopted at [full address in France]. The managing director is appointed as [Name], empowered to represent the company in all acts of management and administration. The Articles of Association are approved as presented. All shareholders waive pre-emptive subscription rights. This resolution is passed in accordance with the provisions of the Code de commerce and shall be registered with the competent authorities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any formal defects within the prescribed period

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Publish the acte de constitution in the Bulletin Officiel des Annonces Civiles et Commerciales (BODACC); obtain the SIREN number from INSEE.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of acte de constitution
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Amend publication if necessary within 30 days

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) - impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: French SARL entities obtain SIREN/SIRET via Guichet Unique and VAT ID (TVA) from DGFiP; foreign entities register for VAT if turnover exceeds €35,000 or for intra-EU services.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available; compliance with French corporate tax rules and potential hybrid mismatch adjustments under EU directives.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time e-invoicing (facturation électronique) for all B2B transactions through the PEPES platform; digital VAT stamping and API-based clearance with tax authorities.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT applies to goods exported outside the EU upon proof of export; offshore services zero-rated if performed outside EU and invoiced to non-EU recipient with supporting documentation.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Penalties include fines up to 80% of evaded VAT, interest, and potential criminal sanctions for fraudulent claims; retrospective adjustments apply.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (French Central Bank) and the Direction Générale du Trésor (DG Trésor) of the French Ministry of Economy and Finance; the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR) supervises banking conduct, and the European Central Bank (ECB) retains monetary and macro-prudential authority over the euro area.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The euro is fully convertible in France. Under the Code Monétaire et Financier (Articles L. 151-1 to L. 165-2) and the TFEU (Articles 63-66), no exchange-control authorization is required for current-account transactions (legal fees, consulting services, royalties) or capital-account operations (share-capital subscription, dividend distribution, loan repayment). Profit remittance from the SARL to non-resident shareholders is legally unrestricted as an FX matter, subject only to corporate tax withholding and documentary proof. The capital/current-account distinction survives only for statistical classification, not for regulatory permission. The residual obligation is statistical: cross-border settlements of EUR 500,000 or more per calendar month must be reported to the Banque de France for balance-of-payments purposes, which does not constitute a convertibility restriction.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France imposes no export-proceeds surrender requirement: the mandatory conversion ratio is 0% and there is no statutory deadline for repatriating or converting export proceeds. A French exporter may retain 100% of export earnings in euro or on a foreign-currency account (compte en devises) at a licensed bank, indefinitely, without prior permission or conversion. The only attachment is the Banque de France monthly balance-of-payments declaration for settlements equal to or exceeding EUR 500,000 per calendar month, which is purely statistical and not a surrender or conversion obligation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements (dépôt des comptes annuels): balance sheet, income statement, annexes, and approval minutes
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce via the INPI guichet unique / Registre National des Entreprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders' meeting must approve the accounts within six months of the fiscal year-end; the filed copy must be lodged with the commercial registry within one month after approval. Court-ordered extension is available.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or omitted deposit exposes the legal representative to a €1,500 criminal fine, compulsory filing by court order under an astreinte, and eventual administrative strike-off (radiation) from the RCS for persistent non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (déclaration de résultat n° 2065 and supporting tax schedules)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) – Service des Impôts des Entreprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a 31 December year-end, filing deadline is no later than the second business day after 1 May of the following year; for other fiscal year-ends, within three months after the closing date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers a 5% automatic late-filing penalty plus 0.50% monthly late-payment interest; deliberate failure permits lump-sum tax assessment by DGFiP and personal liability of the manager.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual VAT settlement return (CA12) for taxpayers under the simplified VAT regime
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: The CA12 annual return for the prior calendar year is due by 3 May, and the balancing payment is due at the same time; companies under the actual VAT regime file monthly or quarterly CA3 returns instead.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing and payment impose an automatic 5% penalty plus monthly interest on the unpaid VAT; material inaccuracies may be penalised at 40% of the amount, with possible criminal tax sanctions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial owner (UBO) record verification/update filed to the national companies register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registre National des Entreprises (RNE) operated by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No separate annual UBO filing is required when information is unchanged; any update to beneficial ownership or listed particulars must be lodged within 30 days from the date of change.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Obligation to publish the RBE update within 30 days; omission or false declaration exposes the company and the legal representative to administrative and criminal fines, and may block delivery of the Kbis extract until regularised.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) for a French SARL when at least two of three thresholds are exceeded: balance-sheet total above EUR 4,000,000, net turnover above EUR 8,000,000, average workforce above 50; court-appointed auditor or articles of association may require an audit even below these thresholds.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général) as codified by the Autorité des Normes Comptables; IFRS is mandatory only for consolidated accounts of listed groups; annual accounts of a SARL must be denominated in euros.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France does not impose a separate annual UBO confirmation filing. UBO information is registered at formation and must be refiled within 30 days of any change; the annual register audit must verify that the current RBE record is consistent with the share register and the registered office details.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members / share movement register (registre des mouvements de titres)
Register of Directors / appointment and nomination records of the gérant
Minute Book (registre des procès-verbaux des assemblées générales et décisions des associés)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 120 – USD 900 per year depending on the commercial registered office and corporate agent service provider location in France.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 – USD 8,000 per year for a statutory audit of a small to mid-sized SARL, excluding additional special-purpose reports and group consolidation work.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: R&D tax credit, innovation tax credit, reduced rate for SMEs (15% on first €42,500 profit)

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Déclaration de résultat (Formulaire 1200-A) via impots.gouv.fr electronic filing portal

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 0.75% of tax due per month of delay, capped at 5% of tax; plus 0.2% monthly interest on unpaid tax; criminal penalties for evasion

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for EU/EEA recipients; 12.8% for other non-residents (reduced by treaties to 0-15%)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Submit Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) and completed DTA application form to French tax authorities via impots.gouv.fr; approval within 6 months typically
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: 0% under most treaties; Interest: 0% under EU directives, 10% otherwise (reduced by treaties)

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: 750 million EUR consolidated group revenue for Master File; 100,000 EUR intra-group transactions for Local File
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable to entities in high-risk sectors; requires adequate employees, premises, and core income-generating activities; non-compliance triggers recharacterization of profits

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate omission or understatement of taxable income or false declarations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties: fines up to 80% of evaded tax, imprisonment up to 5 years, plus civil restitution
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Piercing the corporate veil: directors face personal criminal liability, imprisonment, and disqualification from management

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Creating or using a company without economic substance solely for tax purposes
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recharacterization of transactions; denial of deductions; penalties up to 500,000 EUR or 5% of turnover
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil liability for restitution of tax benefits; potential criminal sanctions if fraudulent

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain adequate TP documentation or suspicious transaction reporting
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to 5% of annual turnover; criminal penalties for willful non-compliance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal fines, imprisonment for serious breaches, and disqualification
